mode_note: Office mode (owner, 2026-10-17): nothing runs on a schedule; every run is started from the office app. Plan slate, script and final video wait for the owner's approval. The office never posts.
id_note: Office ids of course and interview start at 101 so they never collide with ai-course. The series track (prefix a) has the id number equal to the day: Day 1 is a001, Day 150 is a150.
daily_note: Work day (owner, 2026-10-19): 3 reels a day, 1 series day (a###) and 2 interview reels (q##). Generic (e##) and course (r##) are retired for now: nothing is planned or built for them, their ids and finished reels stay. The same set is in team.json (daily) and is what the Start-the-day tap sends.
